  GROUP BY territoryid, name
)

  ROUND((revenue_2024 - revenue_2023)::NUMERIC, 2) AS revenue_increase
FROM revenue_pivot
WHERE revenue_2023 > 0 AND revenue_2024 > 0
ORDER BY revenue_increase DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM hiredate) AS hire_year, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM humanresources.employee WHERE hiredate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM hiredate) ORDER BY hire_year;

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM poh.orderdate)::INTEGER AS year, ROUND(SUM(poh.subtotal + poh.taxamt + poh.freight)::NUMERIC, 2) AS total_spend FROM purchasing.purchaseorderheader poh GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM poh.orderdate) ORDER BY year;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', soh.orderdate)::date AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT soh.salesorderid) AS order_count FROM sales.salesorderheader soh WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM soh.orderdate) = 2024 GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', soh.orderdate) ORDER BY order_count ASC LIMIT 1;
